notes.title: Interactive Gramophone
notes.notes:
Using a gramophone, you can listen to vinyl records that are hidden in different locations. If you have collected all the records, you will receive the achievement.

*[i]Optimized for both keyboard/mouse and gamepad.[/i]

[previewyoutube=HM4BmDJwdQc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gordon Baker Radio Hour
notes.notes:
[b]Gordon Baker Radio Hour[/b]

Gordon Baker goes on air every day and takes calls from listeners, discussing various news in the town of Northville.

You can take part in his radio broadcast by recording the call with your microphone! This video demonstrates what it looks like (work in progress).

[i]*This is one of the types of Voice Events that uses the player's microphone. They do not affect gameplay and can be disabled in the game settings.[/i]

[previewyoutube=rp-F-jnBBqQ;full][/previewyoutube]
